title: Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility — Cost-Share and Allowed-Amount Schedule
content:
This schedule lists, for each payer class of **Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility**, the figures that decide how much of a durable medical equipment (DME) claim line the patient owes when the class is the primary coverage, and the contracted allowed amount the class recognises.

## Schedule by payer class

| Payer class | Annual deductible (USD per benefit year) | DME coinsurance (percent of allowed) | Medicaid copay per DME line (USD) | Out-of-pocket maximum (USD) | Deductible counts toward the out-of-pocket maximum | Allowed amount (percent of fee schedule) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 283.00 | 20 | 0.00 | 0.00 (none) | no | 100 |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 0.00 | 20 | 0.00 | 5900.00 | yes | 96 |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 0.00 | 20 | 0.00 | 7550.00 | yes | 98 |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 0.00 | 0 | 3.00 | 0.00 (none) | no | 82 |
| Commercial HMO | 500.00 | 10 | 0.00 | 4500.00 | yes | 105 |
| Commercial PPO | 1500.00 | 20 | 0.00 | 6800.00 | yes | 112 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 0.00 | 0 | 0.00 | 0.00 (none) | no | 100 |

## Definitions of the columns

1. **Annual deductible** — the annual deductible the patient satisfies before coinsurance applies to DME claim lines when this coverage is primary, in USD per benefit year.
2. **DME coinsurance** — the coinsurance percentage of the allowed amount owed by the patient on DME lines after the deductible, when this coverage is primary.
3. **Medicaid copay per DME line** — the fixed copayment per DME claim line owed by a Medicaid recipient who is not a QMB, in USD; 0.00 for classes without a per-line copay.
4. **Out-of-pocket maximum** — the in-network out-of-pocket maximum for the benefit year after which the patient owes no further deductible, coinsurance or copay, in USD; 0.00 means no out-of-pocket maximum exists for the class.
5. **Deductible counts toward the out-of-pocket maximum** — whether amounts applied to the deductible also count toward the out-of-pocket maximum.
6. **Allowed amount** — the contracted allowed amount as a percentage of the Summit Ridge fee schedule (the published DMEPOS fee schedule amounts carried in each equipment charter).

## Points of reading

- Three classes show 0.00 in the out-of-pocket column: Original Medicare Part B, Medicaid Fee-for-Service and Medicare Supplement Plan G. For them 0.00 is not a cap of zero; it records that no out-of-pocket maximum exists.
- Only Medicaid Fee-for-Service carries a per-line copay (3.00); every other class shows 0.00 there.
- Hypothetical illustration: a fee-schedule amount of 200.00 on a line gives an allowed amount of 224.00 under Commercial PPO (112 percent) and 164.00 under Medicaid Fee-for-Service (82 percent).
